responseTime.title: Response Time (s)
responseTime.tooltip: How long the mod takes to null the velocity error. Higher is gentler.

deadband.title: Deadband (m/s)
deadband.tooltip: Velocity error below this commands no thrust. Prevents chattering.

minFuelFraction.title: Minimum Fuel Fraction
minFuelFraction.tooltip: Orbit assist cuts out below this much remaining fuel.

engageDistanceThreshold.title: Engage Distance Threshold (m)
engageDistanceThreshold.tooltip: Orbit assist can only be engaged within this distance of the target body. Does not affect an already-engaged orbit.
